So the vault supplied USDC into the wstUSR/USDC market and borrowers borrowed it against wstUSR collateral. So the vault increased exposure to wstUSR collateral borrowers during the depeg. That's bad — borrowing against wstUSR at LLTV 91.5% while USR trades at ~0.04 means borrowers are borrowing max and will be undercollateralized; bad debt likely.

Now, the user's position: $1,000 USDC in the vault. The vault is now illiquid: withdrawable 0 USDC as of 09:00. The vault has 4.95M (14.8%) stuck in wstUSR/USDC market at 100% utilization, where the collateral (wstUSR) is derived from USR which was exploited — 80M unbacked USR minted, exploiter staked into wstUSR and exited via swapping wstUSR.

The vault's 4.95M USDC supplied to that market is borrowed at 100% utilization against wstUSR collateral. If that collateral includes unbacked/exploited wstUSR, the vault faces bad debt — borrowers default, collateral worthless, lenders (including our vault) take losses.
